title: S&T Bancorp, Inc. Announces $100 Million Share Repurchase Program
summary: ST Bancorp, Inc. (ST) (NASDAQ: STBA), the holding company for ST Bank, announced that the board of directors authorized a new $100 million share repurchase program at its meeting held July 22, 2026. The new program will replace the existing share repurchase program effective July 27, 2026, and is set to expire August 31, 2027. The remaining capacity under the existing share repurchase program was terminated. This repurchase authorization permits ST to repurchase shares of ST's common stock from time to time through a combination of open market and privately negotiated repurchases up to the authorized $100 million aggregate value of ST's common stock.
